description: This file defines the TranslationService class implementing translation functionalities, including text translation and retrieval of translations for workflow steps and event types, utilizing external repositories and constants.

classes.name: TranslationService
classes.description: Implements translation operations including text translation and fetching translations for workflow steps and event types.

methods.name: getTargetLocales
methods.description: Returns a list of target locales excluding the source locale.

methods.name: translateText
methods.description: Translates given text into multiple target locales, handling errors and failed translations.

methods.name: getWorkflowStepTranslation
methods.description: Retrieves translated body and/or subject for a workflow step based on options.

methods.name: getEventTypeTranslation
methods.description: Retrieves translated title and/or description for an event type based on options.
